# evaluateCompliance

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Evaluates a layout snapshot against the PDF/UA-1 accessibility rules and returns a per-element report. Pure and deterministic.

The rules are checked *unconditionally* (independent of whether the document opted into `AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`), so the report answers "is this document accessible, and if not, where?" for any document. When the document did not opt into tagging, a single document-level [`ComplianceSeverity.Info`](compliance-severity.md#info) finding frames the rest as advisory rather than hard violations.

`options` selects which rule *families* run — see [`CompliancePreflightOptions`](compliance-preflight-options.md). Omitting it runs everything, so the one-argument call is unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
evaluateCompliance(snapshot: LayoutSnapshot, options?: CompliancePreflightOptions): ComplianceReport
```
